description: Build the FULL chat composer, extending p2a's minimal ChatComposer. Adds the attachment drawer + pin chips, the branch indicator, the provider·model picker, a SEPARATE effort chip, and ChatComposerInput's @// autocomplete + paste/drop. STATUS: US-301/302/303 are done; the picker was then REBUILT in-chat against Paper artboard 122-1 and effort was SPLIT into its own control (see architecture below), so US-303's original single fused chip no longer describes the code. REMAINING: US-304a (rich-input plumbing — assignable now), US-304b (typeahead menu design pass — BLOCKED on an artboard) and US-305 (assemble). US-305 needs the input WORKING, not final-styled, so it does not wait on US-304b. DEPENDS ON p2a. Reuses v1's pin/provider logic via ui/src/v2/lib adapters; gateway + v1 UNCHANGED. READ docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §10 (Astryx chat kit) BEFORE any story.

If Randy adds state frames later, match them.

conventions.dependsOnP2a: Extends ui/src/v2/chat/V2Composer.tsx from p2a (which established ChatComposer + ChatComposerInput + ChatSendButton). Do not rebuild it — add the slots below.
conventions.astryxChatKit: Compose the Astryx Chat kit (import from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat'; confirm props with `npx astryx component <Name> --json`): ChatComposer (slots), ChatComposerDrawer, ChatComposerTokenElement, ChatComposerInput, ChatSendButton. See docs §10 + prd-v2-p2a-chat-core.json → astryxChatComponents.
conventions.reuseLogic: Reuse v1's real logic via ui/src/v2/lib adapters — attachment/pin serialization (src/agent/attachments.ts is server-side; v1 PinPicker + send opts are the client reference), the provider registry (GET /api/agent/providers), and the send opts shape (model/effort/permission). Do NOT modify src/ or v1 components.
conventions.astryxOnly: Astryx + ui/src/v2/tokens.css only. No shadcn/Radix, no Tailwind, no raw <div>/hex/px. The provider·model·effort picker popover is custom UI — build it from Astryx Menu/Popover/Layout primitives (`npx astryx search menu|popover`), not Radix.
conventions.v1Untouched: v1 renders pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF.
conventions.gatewayRule: Never run a human's :3747/:5173 from an agent session. Throwaway ports only; verify with automate-browser (VITE_CONAN_V2=1).

architecture.modelVsEffort: LOAD-BEARING: provider+model is the thread's IDENTITY — the gateway relaunches a resumed thread on its saved provider — so ModelPicker LOCKS after turn 1. Effort is a PER-TURN parameter (fresh process each turn), so EffortChip is a SEPARATE sibling control that NEVER locks. Do not re-fuse them; v1 did and it wrongly froze effort.
architecture.shipped: ui/src/v2/chat/composer/: ModelPicker.tsx (Paper artboard 122-1 — 406px panel pinned to --conan-picker-height 371px so it doesn't resize between providers, icon rail with real brand marks, search, rows with ⌘N chips, selected = wash + 2px accent bar, bottom-pinned keyboard-hint footer), EffortChip.tsx (Astryx DropdownMenu over capabilities.effortModes; absent when a provider has none), ProviderGlyph.tsx (shared SVG marks). 91/91 vitest.
